title: Replay one-argument +, *, and distinct from the clause log
summary: The clause-log replay now rebuilds one-argument (+ t), (* t), and (distinct t) as the parser's own terms, so inputs whose assertions after a folded-to-false one contain them are certified in Lean instead of rejected. Python-only change with new tests across LIA, LRA, LIRA, UFLIA, arrays, and UF; merged on a passing local gate.
